Information we collect
{app} does not require an account, and we do not collect, sell or share your personal information on our own servers.

Data on your device
Content you create, open or save in the app (such as files, settings and preferences) stays on your device.

Ads and third-party services
Some of our apps may show ads through Google AdMob. Google may use device identifiers such as the advertising ID to serve and measure ads. See https://policies.google.com/privacy. You can reset or delete your advertising ID in your Android settings.

Internet access
If the app loads online content, requests go directly from your device to the service that provides it. Those services have their own privacy policies.

Permissions
The app asks only for permissions needed for its features, such as access to files you choose to open.

Children
Our apps are not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

Changes and contact
We may update this policy and will change the date above. Questions: labsdevapps@gmail.com.

**Privacy Policy – Labs Dev Hub**
Last updated: November 14, 2026

Labs Dev Hub is a catalog app that shows the Android apps published by Labs Dev Apps.

**Information we collect:** We do not collect, store or share personal information. The app does not require an account.

**Internet access:** The app loads its content from our website. When you use the language translation feature, the page may load Google Translate from Google's servers. Google's privacy policy applies: https://policies.google.com/privacy

**Permissions:** The app only uses the internet permission.

**Children:** The app is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from children.

**Changes:** We may update this policy and will change the date above.

**Contact:** labsdevapps@gmail.com

## Privacy Policy – AI App Forge

**Last updated:** November 18, 2026
**Developer:** Labs Dev Apps
**App:** AI App Forge (`com.labsdevapps.aiappforge`)
**Contact:** labsdevapps@gmail.com

### 1. Overview
AI App Forge lets you turn HTML code into an Android APK or AAB directly on your device. This policy explains what information the app handles and how. We do not run user accounts and we do not operate a server that collects your data.

### 2. Information we do not collect
We do not require registration. We do not collect your name, email address, location, contacts, photos or any other personal information, and we do not send the HTML code, files, icons or apps you create to our servers. Building, signing and packaging happen on your device.

### 3. Data stored on your device
The app stores some data locally on your device only:
- Settings and preferences, such as language and ad-free time remaining.
- Signing keys and signing settings used to sign the apps you build.
- Files you add to a project, and the APK/AAB files you generate.

This data stays on your device. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data removes it.

### 4. Clipboard
The app reads the clipboard only when you ask it to, for example to paste HTML code. The app may also copy text to the clipboard, such as a prompt or an email address. Clipboard contents are not sent to us.

### 5. Internet access
The app uses the internet for two purposes:
- To show ads (see section 6).
- To download external resources (scripts, stylesheets, images) that your HTML refers to, so they can be bundled into your app. These requests go directly from your device to the address in your code. We do not see them.

### 6. Advertising
The app shows ads provided by Google AdMob (Google Mobile Ads SDK). Google and its partners may collect and use device identifiers (such as the Android advertising ID), IP address, and ad-interaction data to serve and measure ads and to prevent fraud. Where required, such as in the EEA and the UK, the app asks for your consent through Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP) before showing personalized ads.

You can manage ad personalization in your device's Settings (Google > Ads), and learn more in Google's policies at https://policies.google.com/privacy and https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads.

The app offers an option to watch ads in exchange for a period without ads. Watching ads is always optional.

### 7. Permissions
- **Internet:** to show ads and fetch resources referenced in your code.
- **Notifications:** to show build or status notifications.
- **Vibration:** for haptic feedback.
- **Install packages:** only so you can install the APK you built. Installation always requires your confirmation.

### 8. Feedback by email
If you choose "Send feedback", the app opens your email app with a message addressed to labsdevapps@gmail.com. We receive only what you choose to send. We use it only to respond to you and improve the app.

### 9. Apps you create
Apps you build with AI App Forge are your own. You are responsible for their content, for their own privacy policy, and for complying with the laws and store policies that apply to them. If you add ads or other SDKs to your apps, you must disclose that in their privacy policy.

### 10. Sharing of information
We do not sell your personal information. The only third party that processes data through the app is Google, through the advertising services described in section 6.

### 11. Children
AI App Forge is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

### 12. Security
Your data stays on your device. We rely on the security of your device and of Android to protect it, so please keep your device and your signing keys safe.

### 13. Changes to this policy
We may update this policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date above will change when we do. Continued use of the app means you accept the updated policy.

### 14. Contact
For questions or requests about this policy, email **labsdevapps@gmail.com**.
